extraction_notes: The 2025 report is not on file with the state (only its certification form), so the 2024 CCR is used. Its title and report date (June 3, 2025) say 2024 but the 'About This Report' sentence still says 'January 1 to December 31, 2022' (template leftover); sample dates are 10/23/2024 and 10/10/23; data_year recorded as 2024. The tables mix per-well results into single cells (Well 01 / Well 02), so sodium, hardness, nitrate and perchlorate are split into one entry per well with source_group = well; the lead/copper table has columns shifted (see notes). No secondary-standard table is printed.
